---
description: Tabs wrapper
title: Tabs
---
`bcgov-tabs` provides a shadow-DOM wrapper with a default slot. It does not manage tab selection or add tab keyboard or ARIA behavior.

## Example

```html
<bcgov-tabs>
	<bcgov-tab><h2>Overview</h2><p>First panel content.</p></bcgov-tab>
	<bcgov-tab><h2>Details</h2><p>Second panel content.</p></bcgov-tab>
</bcgov-tabs>
```
